hotels.title: Maldives All-Inclusive Luxury Villas with Free-Flow Drinks & Roundtrip Domestic Transfers
hotels.description: Here, luxury takes on a new dimension amidst an underwater kingdom in the Maldives’ deepest atoll - the ‘Living Island’ of Hadahaa. Boasting just 51 villas across a private tropical island, this five-star resort whisks you away from reality and straight into nature’s paradise, with a host of activities that celebrate its beautifully preserved location. Harness the holistic healing powers of The Vidhun Spa with a tension-melting massage and continue your state of serenity with a complimentary yoga class as the Maldivian sunset illuminates the sky. Take a dip in one of the resort’s pools, or sample culinary excellence at one of the three restaurants on-site, including the overwater Koi at the Drift. Delve deeper into the preservation of marine ecosystems at the Blue Journeys Dive and Activity Centre, from which you can head out on a guided snorkelling excursion in the hotel’s 360-degree house reef, inhabited by dazzling tropical fish species. With the resort’s sustainable practices safeguarding the delicate environment, this region is one of the most sought-after destinations for marine exploration.
